slides.prompt: Trà Sư cajuput forest (rừng tràm Trà Sư), An Giang, Vietnam, bright morning in the flood season. A narrow waterway carpeted with bright green duckweed winds between tall slender cajuput trees, soft sunbeams slanting through the canopy and light haze. One small wooden sampan glides through the duckweed, leaving a dark trail: a young Vietnamese couple in modern casual clothes (linen shirt, simple T-shirt, sunglasses pushed up) sit in it, rowed by a local boatwoman wearing a long-sleeve sun-protection jacket (áo chống nắng) and a wide bucket hat, as boat rowers really dress there today. Small in the middle of the frame. Foreground: cajuput leaves and branches strongly out of focus. Palette: fresh duckweed green and soft morning gold

Inside Trà Sư cajuput forest, An Giang, Vietnam, morning. Long rays of sunlight pour down between rows of tall slender cajuput tree trunks onto a calm waterway covered with a smooth carpet of bright green duckweed, light mist in the air, a white egret standing far away on the water. No people. Foreground: a cajuput branch, strongly out of focus. Palette: fresh green with warm gold light

Close-up at water level in Trà Sư cajuput forest, An Giang: the bright green duckweed carpet parted by the dark curving wake of a passing wooden boat, morning sunlight sparkling on the water, cajuput trunks and their reflections dissolved into soft blur behind. Palette: fresh green, dark teal water and soft gold

caption: Trà Sư mùa nước nổi.
share: gửi cho đứa bạn miền Tây hay rủ bạn về quê chơi.

hook: 20/10 mua hoa cho mẹ ở chợ hoa Hồ Thị Kỷ

slides.prompt: Hồ Thị Kỷ flower market alley in Saigon at dusk on Vietnamese Women's Day: a narrow alley packed with flower stalls, buckets of roses, lilies, baby's breath and sunflowers under warm string lights and bare bulbs, shop signs softly glowing, the sky deep peach above the low buildings. A few shoppers browsing, small and soft. A couple of modern scooters (Honda Vision, a VinFast electric scooter) parked at the edge of the alley. Foreground: a bucket of roses strongly out of focus. Palette: peach, warm pink and warm lamplight

Close-up of a fresh flower bouquet being wrapped at a stall in Hồ Thị Kỷ flower market, Saigon, at dusk: pastel pink roses and white baby's breath in modern kraft paper and translucent wrapping with a satin ribbon, held in the hands of a young Vietnamese florist, warm string lights and other flower buckets dissolved into soft bokeh behind. Palette: soft pink, cream and warm gold

Saigon at dusk on Vietnamese Women's Day, just outside Hồ Thị Kỷ flower market: a young Vietnamese woman in a modern oversized shirt, wide-leg jeans and white sneakers, with a tote bag, walking away hand in hand with her mother, who wears a neat modern blouse and trousers; the mother holds a bouquet of pink roses. Seen from behind, small in the frame, a natural candid moment. The street behind has warm shop lights and a few modern scooters and a green-jacketed ride-hailing rider gliding past in soft motion blur. Foreground: flowers from a stall, strongly out of focus. Palette: peach dusk, warm pink and lamplight

caption: 20/10, ghé Hồ Thị Kỷ mua hoa cho mẹ nha.
share: tag người phụ nữ bạn muốn tặng hoa hôm nay.

hook: Hoa đăng dưới cầu Trường Tiền

slides.prompt: Huế, Vietnam, at night: the Trường Tiền Bridge with its six graceful steel arches lit up in soft shifting colour lights, reflected in the calm, wide Perfume River (sông Hương). A few small paper flower lanterns (hoa đăng) with candles float on the dark water in the foreground. Deep blue night sky, clean and mostly empty. No people. Foreground: a few riverside leaves, strongly out of focus. Palette: deep blue night with warm gold and soft violet light

The Perfume River in Huế at night: many small paper flower lanterns (hoa đăng) with candles drifting slowly on the dark water, their warm reflections trembling, and further out a lit wooden dragon boat with warm lanterns, small and soft. The arches of the Trường Tiền Bridge glow faintly in the distance. No people visible. Palette: deep blue and violet water with warm candle gold

Close-up at water level on the Perfume River in Huế at night: one paper flower lantern (hoa đăng) shaped like a lotus, its candle flame glowing, sharp in soft focus, floating on dark rippling water; behind it the lit arches of the Trường Tiền Bridge dissolved into large soft golden and violet bokeh. Palette: deep blue, violet and warm gold

caption: hoa đăng dưới cầu Trường Tiền.
share: gửi cho người muốn cùng về Huế một lần.
